geo_note: Google ignores the uule parameter (measured 2026-08-18: pinning to Mumbai, to Guntur, and sending no parameter all returned identical Vijayawada-weighted SERPs). This machine's egress IP geolocates to Vijayawada, ~30 km away, so an unqualified query silently returns the wrong market. Geography therefore comes from the city name inside the query text, which is also how the June 2026 baseline was captured.
locality_note: Guntur is a small city: patients search the city, not the neighbourhood. localities[] is kept for address matching only — see 'query writing.md'.
